name: chalkreel
description: Create hand-drawn whiteboard explainer videos from a prompt: presenter, AI voice-over, your pictures, MP4 export.

interface.longDescription:
Chalkreel turns an idea into a hand-drawn whiteboard explainer video, right in the chat.

Ask for a video on any topic — a lesson, a product pitch, a how-to, a story — and Chalkreel draws it scene by scene: titles and short board text written by a marker hand, bullet lists, charts, timelines and flowcharts, 229 doodle props and 24 characters who can speak lines in speech bubbles. A player appears in the conversation where you can play the video, jump between scenes and see every scene as a thumbnail.

What you can do:
• Presenter: add a host character who stands in every scene and speaks the narration, with lips in sync.
• AI voice-over: natural AI voices read the narration and the characters' lines (the voices are AI-generated).
• Your pictures: put photos, diagrams or images you made in ChatGPT into scenes — tap ＋ on a scene in the player to add them from your device or your ChatGPT files.
• Formats and looks: 16:9, 9:16 for Shorts, Reels and TikTok, or square; whiteboard, chalkboard, blueprint, notebook, kraft paper and more; marker, pencil, chalk or brush hands; background music and captions.
• 47 templates for education, business, marketing, social media and science.
• Changes in plain words: "make scene 2 longer", "switch to a chalkboard", "add calm music" — Chalkreel redraws the video.
• MP4 export: export a 720p MP4 with a small "Made with Chalkreel" mark, encoded in your browser.
• Keep editing: download the Chalkreel project and open it in Chalkreel for iOS or Windows.

Privacy: Chalkreel has no accounts, no ads and no tracking, and its server stores nothing. Rendering and MP4 export happen in your browser; voice-over text is sent to OpenAI's text-to-speech API to make the audio. Details at chalkreel.app/privacy.

Notes: MP4 export needs a browser with H.264 encoding (current Chrome or Edge, Safari 17+). Board text supports Latin, Greek, Cyrillic and Vietnamese scripts.
defaultPrompt: Make a whiteboard video explaining how vaccines train the immune system, with a presenter and voice-over
Create a 30-second vertical TikTok video with 3 tips to sleep better
Turn my pictures into a short video, one picture per scene

positive.description: Explainer video with a presenter and AI voice-over
positive.prompt: Make a 4-scene whiteboard video with Chalkreel explaining how vaccines train the immune system, with a presenter and voice-over.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls create_video with four scenes (title, short narration, props or bullets) and a presenter. The Chalkreel player appears with a 4-scene whiteboard video and a "Voice: …" chip; the same presenter stands in every scene and speaks the narration with lip sync when played. The user can play, jump between scene thumbnails, Export MP4 and Download project.

positive.prompt: Use Chalkreel to create a 30-second vertical video for TikTok with 3 tips to sleep better, on a chalkboard.
positive.expected_behavior: create_video is called with format "vertical", board "chalkboard" and three tip scenes. The player shows a 9:16 video drawn in chalk on a green chalkboard, about 20–30 seconds long, with 3 scene thumbnails; the header reads "3 scenes · 0:2x · 9:16".

positive.prompt: Which Chalkreel templates are there for teachers and education?
positive.expected_behavior: list_templates is called with category "education" (or a query). ChatGPT lists the matching templates (e.g. Concept Explainer, Course Trailer, lesson or quiz templates) with a one-line summary each and offers to make a video from one. No player appears because no video was created.

positive.description: Fill a template with the user's own text
positive.prompt: Use Chalkreel's Feature Spotlight template to announce dark mode in my to-do app TaskFox.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds tpl.product.feature-spotlight (list_templates), reads its text slots (get_template), then calls create_from_template with replacement texts about TaskFox's dark mode. The player shows a 3-scene, ~18-second 16:9 before/after video whose board text and narration are about TaskFox.

positive.description: Search the doodle library, make a video, then edit it
positive.prompt: Find Chalkreel doodles about money, then make a 3-scene video on budgeting basics using them. After it appears, ask: "Make it a blueprint board and add calm music."
positive.expected_behavior: search_library (query "money", kind "props") returns props such as Money Bag, Coin Stack and Bank Note; create_video draws a 3-scene budgeting video using some of them. On the follow-up ChatGPT calls create_video again with the full spec plus board "blueprint" and music "music.calm"; a new player shows the same video on a blue blueprint background with background music.

negative.description: Editing an existing video file — Chalkreel only creates new whiteboard videos and cannot trim or edit uploaded videos
negative.prompt: Here's my vacation.mp4. Cut the first 10 seconds and add a song to it.

negative.description: A slide deck, not an animated video — ChatGPT should make the presentation itself
negative.prompt: Make a PowerPoint presentation with 8 slides about our Q3 sales results.

negative.description: A single still image — ChatGPT's own image generation, not a narrated video
negative.prompt: Draw a cute watercolor picture of a cat sitting on a windowsill.

review.commerce_description: Chalkreel does not sell anything in ChatGPT: no purchases, subscriptions, paywall or locked features; every feature, including MP4 export, is available to everyone.

publication.release_notes: Chalkreel 1.0 — whiteboard explainer videos in ChatGPT. Describe a topic and Chalkreel draws it scene by scene with hand-drawn titles, doodles, charts and characters, plus background music. Add a presenter who talks through the video in an AI voice with lip sync, start from 47 templates, add your own pictures with ＋ in the player, export a 720p MP4 in your browser, or download the project for the Chalkreel iOS and Windows apps.
